samples.title: Beam bending with real units
samples.description: A simply supported beam: moment, section capacity and a utilisation check. Units are real, so a stress times a section modulus comes out in kN.m.

samples.title: Short column in compression
samples.description: Axial capacity of a short column, with several quantities on one line and a pass or fail message.

samples.title: Loads on a floor (table, vectors)
samples.description: A Markdown table of loads, load combinations in kPa, a line load per beam, and vector and matrix literals.

samples.title: Bending moment diagram (plot)
samples.description: A moment function defined with a name(x): line and plotted with a plot line.

samples.title: Bending stress with LaTeX prose
samples.description: Inline and display LaTeX in the prose and in notes, rendered with KaTeX.

samples.title: Mixing with Calcpad code and loops
samples.description: Sheet lines, a raw Calcpad loop that shares variables with them, and friendly indented for and if blocks.

samples.title: Beam deflection (sheet version, with a plot)
samples.description: The deflection and rotation of a simply supported beam under a uniform load, with the deflection curve plotted. A short sheet version of the bundled deflection example.

samples.title: Cantilever tip deflection (sheet version, with a loop)
samples.description: Tip deflection, rotation and fixed-end moment of a cantilever, and a for loop over load multiples. A short sheet version of the bundled cantilever example.

samples.title: Beam explorer with Python and Plotly
samples.file: sheet-samples/Beam explorer with Python and Plotly.sheet
samples.description: The sheet form of the beam explorer: a python fence solves a three-span beam for several load cases and draws the results with the Plotly API (make_subplots, a load case menu and two sliders, no script), and quantity lines check the envelope.

samples.title: Beam deflection derived symbolically
samples.description: The midspan deflection of a simply supported beam derived step by step with the Symbolic dialog (integrate, solve for the constants, substitute), typeset as LaTeX, then fed with numbers and checked against the derived curve.

samples.title: Laguerre polynomial roots
samples.description: Coefficients from a loop, every real root from one polyroots call, a residual check and the curve.

samples.title: 3D plate deflection surface
samples.description: A simply supported slab panel by the Navier series, drawn as a rotatable 3D surface with projected contours. The centre deflection is checked against span/250.

samples.title: 3D biaxial column interaction
samples.description: A column's N-Mx-My interaction surface (Bresler load contour) with the design action as a marker, and an inside or outside check.

samples.title: 3D space frame geometry
samples.description: A two-bay, three-storey space frame as 3D lines, each member coloured by utilisation, with hover labels.

samples.title: 3D mode shapes explorer
samples.description: The first nine modes of a simply supported plate on a 3D surface, with a dropdown to switch mode and the frequencies computed.

samples.title: 3D footing reactions bar chart
samples.description: Column reactions on a footing grid as 3D bars (one Mesh3d trace), coloured by load, with a pad area check.

samples.title: Plot gallery: implicit curves, functions, polylines
samples.description: Four plots on a grid in the style of a plotting demo: implicit curves f(x, y) = 0, functions, parametric and noisy curves, polylines with markers, a legend and a second y axis.

samples.title: Animated beam, moving load
samples.description: A point load travels along a simply supported beam: Play, Pause and a slider step through precomputed Plotly frames.

samples.title: Tennis ball flight: drag, spin and trajectory
samples.description: Weight, air drag and the Magnus force from spin on a tennis ball, integrated in a python fence: groundstrokes with different spins landing on the same spot, a map of net clearance against speed and topspin, and flat, slice and kick serves in plan, side and 3D views.
